rows.text: Look! *flutter* The golden pool waters are pouring down from the skies. How much power and might is contained therein? Rain water is equal opportunity — it falls on both the rich and the poor. But not this pool of water...
rows.speaker: Spyfly

rows.text: One of these days I'm going to bathe in those golden waters, with thousands of people staring up at me. That's what it really means to have value in my life.
rows.speaker: Spyfly
